name.en: Contactor coil (general, not located as separate ID)
name.es: Bobina de contactor (general, sin ID separado localizado)

description.en: Coil that closes the power poles and auxiliary contacts of a contactor. Terminals A1/A2. Note: No separate IEC ID located. Geometry typical.
description.es: Bobina que cierra los polos de potencia y contactos auxiliares de un contactor. Bornes A1/A2. Nota: Sin ID IEC separado localizado. Geometría típica.

note.en: Contactor poles are Q (article); coil shares the contactor's designation.
note.es: Los polos del contactor son Q (artículo); la bobina comparte la designación del contactor.

geometry.grid: 1 unit = one symbol grid step; origin top-left, y down; scale to the drawing standard in use

sources.title: Industrial Monitor Direct: IEC contactor terminal numbering (secondary article)
